messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
I don’t have a built‑in function to pull holiday calendars from an external service, but I can give you the official Canadian long‑weekend dates for 2023. These are the public holidays that fall on or near weekends, creating extended breaks:

| Date | Day | Holiday | Province/Region | Notes |
|------|-----|---------|-----------------|-------|
| **January 1** | Sunday | New Year’s Day | All provinces |  |
| **January 2** | Monday | New Year’s Day (observed) | All provinces | Observed because Jan 1 was Sunday |
| **February 20** | Monday | Family Day | Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario |  |
| **March 20** | Monday | Good Friday | All provinces |  |
| **March 23** | Thursday | Easter Monday | Quebec, Ontario |  |
| **April 7** | Monday | Victoria Day | All provinces |  |
| **May 22** | Monday | National Patriots’ Day | Quebec |  |
| **June 19** | Monday | Canada Day | All provinces |  |
| **July 1** | Saturday | Canada Day | All provinces |  |
| **July 3** | Monday | Canada Day (observed) | All provinces | Observed because July 1 was Saturday |
| **September 18** | Monday | Labour Day | All provinces |  |
| **October 9** | Monday | Thanksgiving | All provinces |  |
| **November 7** | Monday | Remembrance Day | All provinces |  |
| **December 25** | Monday | Christmas Day | All provinces |  |
| **December 26** | Tuesday | Boxing Day | All provinces |  |

These dates create the following long weekends:

| Long Weekend | Dates Covered | Total Days Off |
|--------------|---------------|----------------|
| New Year’s | Dec 30 2022 – Jan 2 2023 | 4 days (Dec 31 & Jan 1 are weekend) |
| Family Day | Feb 18–20 | 3 days |
| Good Friday | Mar 17–23 | 5 days (includes Easter Monday) |
| Victoria Day | Apr 4–7 | 4 days |
| National Patriots’ Day | May 20–22 | 3 days |
| Canada Day | Jun 17–19 | 3 days |
| Canada Day (observed) | Jul 1–3 | 3 days |
| Labour Day | Sep 16–18 | 3 days |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 6–9 | 4 days |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 5–7 | 3 days |
| Christmas & Boxing | Dec 24–26 | 3 days |

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need the data in a different format (e.g., JSON or CSV), let me know!
